resources.string: Transport

Godwall\'s own proxy backends — sing-box and v2ray — run at uid 2000 out of the Linux subsystem as loopback proxies the egress chain dials into. They carry only the flows routed through Godwall\'s chain; they change nothing about how other apps reach the network.
sing-box transport

Runs a local SOCKS5/HTTP proxy on 127.0.0.1:10808 that Godwall\'s egress chain dials into. The shipped default egresses directly; add your Shadowsocks, VMess, VLESS, Trojan, WireGuard or Hysteria2 server to the config to route through it. It carries only the flows dialled into that port and changes nothing about other apps\' networking.
v2ray transport

Runs a local SOCKS5 proxy on 127.0.0.1:10809 that Godwall\'s egress chain dials into. The shipped default egresses directly; add your VMess, VLESS, Shadowsocks or Trojan server to the config to route through it. It carries only the TCP flows dialled into that port.
Shadowsocks

Shadowsocks is one of the sing-box backend\'s outbound protocols, so it shares that backend\'s state. \"Running\" means the backend that speaks Shadowsocks is up on 127.0.0.1:10808 — the route through a Shadowsocks server is one you configure in the sing-box outbound, not a remote connection this loopback proxy verifies for you.
WireGuard hop
Would carry chain traffic through a userspace WireGuard tunnel. Not a first-class hop in this build — see the note below.

WireGuard as a first-class chain hop is not in this build. Godwall\'s WireGuard hop backend is firestack\'s packet-level tun2socks data plane (backend.WgKey), which is not wired into this build, and a standalone userspace wireguard-go needs that same data plane to steer flows into the tunnel. sing-box can carry a WireGuard outbound once its ELF is installed, but that is a route configured inside sing-box, not a standalone WireGuard hop. This control stays disabled rather than claim a WireGuard tunnel it cannot carry.
proxychains chaining
Would force an external program\'s connections through a proxy chain. Superseded here — see the note below.

Chaining is native in Godwall: ChainDialer composes SOCKS5 and HTTP CONNECT hops in userspace, so a proxied connection does not need proxychains\' LD_PRELOAD shim — and Godwall deliberately exposes no user shell to run a program through one. proxychains-ng is not shipped and would be redundant. This control stays disabled.
Forward proxy
Send the connections Godwall carries out through an upstream SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy.

Routes the TCP flows Godwall carries through its egress chain out via your upstream SOCKS5/HTTP proxy. SOCKS5 and HTTP CONNECT carry TCP only — UDP is not proxied. It changes nothing about traffic Godwall does not already carry.
SOCKS5
HTTP CONNECT
Exclude applications
Only TCP traffic is sent to the proxy. UDP is not proxied.
The forward proxy is off. Every flow goes out directly.

Your forward-proxy selection is saved, and the upstream carries any flow you route through Godwall\'s egress chain. Forcing every app\'s traffic through it device-wide needs the full-traffic tun2socks data plane, which is not in this build, so a per-app rule here is stored — not yet enforced device-wide.
The forward proxy is enforced: the selected apps\' and sites\' TCP flows are steered through the upstream, and everything else goes direct.
